summary: Empirical studies support the importance of task-oriented documentation, architecture knowledge and decision records. Evidence for a single graphical wiki as the optimal interface remains limited and largely observational.

items.text: Dagenais and Robillard (FSE 2010) studied how developers create and use documentation for open-source projects through interviews and repository observations, emphasizing audience and task fit rather than documentation volume.

A 2024 action-research study of architecture decision records reports benefits and adoption challenges in an industrial setting; context dependence and the small number of organizations limit generalization.
A 2023 industry survey of 45 software architects examines how architecture knowledge is managed and shared, providing adjacent evidence for discoverable knowledge interfaces.
A 2024 exploratory study of LLM-assisted ADR creation found GPT-4 outputs below human-authored decisions in the evaluated setting, warning that agent write access still needs review.
